Our Story

Generations of Trust

SM Gold was founded in 1985 by Master Goldsmith Muhammad Saleem, who started with a small workshop in the heart of Sargodha. What began as a one-man operation has grown into one of the most trusted gold shops in Sarafa Bazar, known for pure gold jewellery and beautiful jewellery design. For nearly four decades, we have served thousands of families, crafting jewelry for weddings, celebrationsand precious moments.
